recipes.title: Essential Sushi Rice Foundation
recipes.description: The most important part of any sushi dish. This recipe guides you through the traditional method of washing, cooking, and seasoning short-grain rice to achieve a perfect pearly texture and balanced flavor.
instructions: Rinse the rice in a mesh strainer under cold running water. Use your hand to gently swirl the rice until the water runs clear. This step is vital to remove excess starch.
Combine the rinsed rice and 2.25 cups water in a heavy-bottomed pot. Bring to a boil over high heat, then immediately reduce heat to the lowest setting.
Cover tightly and simmer for 15 minutes. Remove from the heat and let the rice sit undisturbed for 10 more minutes (do not open the lid).
In a small bowl, whisk together the rice vinegar, sugar, and salt until completely dissolved.

Transfer the hot rice to a large wooden or glass bowl (avoid metal). Slowly pour the vinegar mixture over the rice while using a 'slicing' motion with a rice paddle to fold the liquid in. Do not mash the grains.
Use a fan to cool the rice quickly to room temperature while you fold. Cover with a damp cloth until you are ready to roll your sushi. Do not refrigerate.

recipes.title: Gourmet Alaska Roll
recipes.description: A fresh and creamy roll featuring sashimi-grade salmon and smooth avocado. This inside-out (uramaki) style roll is perfect for salmon lovers seeking a healthy, nutrient-dense sushi option.

ingredients.displayName: Sashimi-grade fresh salmon, sliced into strips

instructions: Place a half sheet of nori on a bamboo rolling mat (makisu). Cover the mat in plastic wrap first to prevent sticking.
Wet your hands with water and spread a thin, even layer of sushi rice over the entire surface of the nori.
Carefully flip the nori over so that the rice is now facing down against the mat.
Arrange the salmon strips, julienned cucumber, and avocado slices in a horizontal line along the center of the nori.
Hold the edge of the mat and roll it tightly away from you, applying gentle pressure to create a firm cylinder.
Remove the mat and use a very sharp, wet knife to slice the roll into 8 uniform rounds. Wipe the knife with a damp towel between every cut for clean slices.

recipes.title: Healthy Dragon Roll
recipes.description: An elegant sushi roll topped with paper-thin avocado slices to resemble dragon scales. We use steamed jumbo shrimp and grilled eel for a protein-rich, non-fried experience.
instructions: Create an inside-out roll with prepared rice on the outside. Place the steamed shrimp and cucumber strips in the center and roll tightly.
Take the peeled avocado halves and slice them into paper-thin crescents.
Fan the avocado slices out with your fingers and carefully drape them over the top of the sushi roll, overlapping them like scales.
If using eel, place thin strips of grilled eel on top of the avocado 'scales'.
Cover the roll with a piece of plastic wrap and use the bamboo mat to gently press the avocado and eel into the rice.
With the plastic wrap still on, slice the roll into 8 pieces. Remove the plastic and drizzle with a thin line of healthy eel sauce.
Decorate the 'head' of the dragon with two cucumber slivers for horns and tiny sriracha dots for eyes.

recipes.title: Chef's Rainbow Roll
recipes.description: A visually stunning roll that showcases a variety of fresh fish. This colorful masterpiece features tuna, salmon, and yellowtail layered over a classic crab and cucumber base.
instructions: Prepare a standard inside-out roll filled with real crab meat and cucumber matchsticks.
Take the sliced tuna, salmon, yellowtail, and avocado and layer them diagonally across the top of the roll, alternating colors to create a rainbow effect.
Cover the fish layer with a piece of plastic wrap and use the bamboo mat to gently press the fish into the roll so it adheres to the rice.
Slice the roll into 8 pieces with the plastic wrap still on (this prevents the fish from sliding off).
Carefully remove the plastic and serve with wasabi and low-sodium soy sauce.

recipes.title: Healthy Spicy Tuna Roll
recipes.description: A light and spicy roll that swaps heavy mayonnaise for creamy Greek yogurt. Made with fresh, minced sashimi-grade tuna and a kick of sriracha.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the minced tuna, sriracha, Greek yogurt, and green onions until well combined and creamy.
Spread a thin layer of rice over a half sheet of nori.
Arrange a line of the spicy tuna mixture and cucumber strips along the center.
Roll tightly using the mat. Slice into 8 pieces and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Fresh Salmon Nigiri
recipes.description: Simple and elegant. High-quality salmon is hand-pressed onto bite-sized pillows of seasoned sushi rice. The ultimate expression of sushi craftsmanship.
instructions: Slice the salmon into uniform rectangles (about 1x2 inches) against the grain at a slight angle.
Wet your palms with vinegared water to prevent sticking.
Scoop 2 tablespoons of rice and shape it into a firm, oval-shaped mound.
Place a small dot of wasabi on the center of the salmon slice.
Lay the salmon over the rice and press down gently with your pointer and middle fingers to secure the fish to the rice.

recipes.title: Ahi Tuna Nigiri
recipes.description: Lean and flavorful bigeye tuna hand-pressed onto perfectly seasoned sushi rice. A pure and traditional sushi experience.
instructions: Slice the tuna into thin, uniform rectangles.
Wet your hands and form small, bite-sized ovals of rice.
Press the tuna slices onto the rice ovals. serve with a side of high-quality soy sauce.

recipes.title: Sweet Inari Tofu Pockets
recipes.description: A kid-friendly and vegetarian sushi classic. Seasoned fried tofu skins are stuffed with savory-sweet sushi rice. Great for lunchboxes!
instructions: Carefully open each tofu pocket without tearing the delicate sides.
Form a small handful of sushi rice into a compact ball.
Gently stuff the rice into the pocket and fold the edges over to seal the bottom.
Top with a few sesame seeds or a tiny slice of avocado for extra flair.

recipes.title: Healthy Spider Hand Roll
recipes.description: A nutritious take on the spider roll. Instead of deep-frying, we pan-sear soft-shell crab until crispy. Rolled into a cone with sprouts and cucumber.
instructions: Lightly season the crab and pan-sear in a teaspoon of oil over medium-high heat for 4-5 minutes per side until crispy.
Hold the nori sheet in your palm. Place a small amount of rice on one side.
Place the crispy crab and cucumber matchsticks diagonally over the rice.
Roll into a cone shape and serve while the crab is still warm.

recipes.title: Yellowtail Nigiri (Hamachi)
recipes.description: Premium yellowtail known for its high fat content and buttery flavor. Simply pressed onto rice and topped with a tiny sliver of green onion.
instructions: Slice the yellowtail into uniform rectangles.
Shape bite-sized pillows of rice.
Press the yellowtail onto the rice and garnish each piece with a tiny sliver of fresh green onion.

recipes.title: Steamed Octopus Nigiri (Tako)
recipes.description: Tender and slightly chewy steamed octopus sliced on a sharp diagonal. A traditional favorite with a mild, sweet flavor.
instructions: Slice the steamed octopus at a very sharp angle to create long, thin pieces.
Form ovals of rice.
Place the octopus on the rice and secure it by wrapping a very thin strip of nori around the middle.

recipes.title: Eel and Cucumber Roll (Unakyu)
recipes.description: A classic savory-sweet roll featuring grilled eel and crunchy cucumber. Glazed with a healthy, honey-based eel sauce.
instructions: Place grilled eel strips and cucumber matchsticks in the center of a rice-covered nori sheet.
Roll tightly. Slice into 8 pieces.
Drizzle each piece with a tiny drop of healthy eel sauce.

recipes.title: Fresh Vegetable Maki
recipes.description: A clean and crunchy vegan roll packed with fresh carrots, cucumber, and pickled radish. Light and high in fiber.
instructions: Place the vegetable strips along the center of a nori sheet covered with a thin layer of rice.
Roll into a tight cylinder. Slice into 6 small pieces (Hoso-maki style).

recipes.title: Spicy Scallop Gunkan
recipes.description: Creamy diced scallops mixed with a touch of sriracha and citrus. Served in a nori-wrapped 'battleship' for a burst of flavor.
instructions: Whisk diced scallops with sriracha and lime juice.
Create nori-wrapped rice mounds.
Spoon the scallop mixture generously onto the top of each.

recipes.title: Negitoro Roll (Fatty Tuna & Onion)
recipes.description: A melt-in-your-mouth delicacy using minced fatty tuna (toro) and sharp green onions. A favorite among sushi connoisseurs.
instructions: Mix the fatty tuna with chopped scallions.
Spread on nori and rice. Roll tightly and slice into 8 rounds.

recipes.title: Steamed Shrimp Nigiri (Ebi)
recipes.description: Sweet, butterflied steamed shrimp pressed onto sushi rice. A mild and firm sushi that's universally loved.
instructions: Skewer shrimp to keep straight. Boil for 2 mins.
Peel, butterfly, and press onto rice ovals.

recipes.title: Squid and Shiso Nigiri
recipes.description: Fresh, scored squid paired with the herbal, mint-like flavor of shiso leaf. A very traditional and refreshing combination.
instructions: Score the squid in a diamond pattern.
Place a piece of shiso on the rice, then press the squid on top.

recipes.title: Creamy Avocado Maki
recipes.description: Simple and satisfying. High-quality avocado provides healthy fats and a buttery texture in this clean vegan roll.
instructions: Roll avocado strips and rice into a thin cylinder. Slice into 6 small rounds.

recipes.title: Scallop Carpaccio Nigiri
recipes.description: Sweet, buttery sea scallops sliced paper-thin and seasoned with a touch of citrus. A melt-in-your-mouth premium delicacy.
instructions: Butterfly the scallops and press onto rice. Season with yuzu pepper.

recipes.title: Lean Tuna Temaki
recipes.description: A quick and fresh hand roll featuring strips of lean bluefin tuna and crisp cucumber. Designed to be eaten immediately while the nori is crisp.
instructions: Roll tuna and rice into a nori cone with cucumber.

recipes.title: Tuna and Avocado Roll
recipes.description: A classic pairing of lean tuna and creamy avocado. This roll provides a great source of protein and healthy monounsaturated fats.
instructions: Roll tuna and avocado inside rice and nori. Slice into 8 rounds.

recipes.title: Pickled Radish Roll (Oshinko)
recipes.description: A traditional vegan roll featuring yellow pickled daikon radish. It offers a bright, crunchy, and salty-sweet flavor profile.
instructions: Roll pickled radish strips in nori and rice. Slice into 6 small rounds.

recipes.title: Horse Mackerel with Ginger
recipes.description: Flavorful horse mackerel (Aji) topped with freshly grated ginger and green onions to balance its rich, oily profile.
instructions: Place fish on rice ovals. Garnish with a tiny mound of ginger and scallions.

recipes.title: Amberjack Nigiri (Kanpachi)
recipes.description: Sleek and firm amberjack pressed onto sushi rice. Kanpachi is known for its clean finish and sophisticated flavor.
instructions: Press fresh amberjack onto bite-sized rice mounds.

recipes.title: Seared Salmon with Sea Salt
recipes.description: Salmon nigiri that has been briefly seared (aburi) to melt the fat and create a smokey, melt-in-your-mouth experience.
instructions: Place salmon on rice. Briefly sear the top with a kitchen torch or in a very hot pan for 5 seconds.

recipes.title: Red Snapper Nigiri (Tai)
recipes.description: Red Snapper (Tai) is a symbol of celebration in Japan. It has a mild, sweet flavor and a firm, clean texture.
instructions: Press fresh snapper onto rice mounds. Season with a tiny squeeze of lime juice.

recipes.title: Cured Mackerel Hand Roll
recipes.description: Cured mackerel (Saba) rolled into a nori cone. The sharp vinegar-cured fish pairs perfectly with the crisp seaweed and warm rice.
instructions: Roll cured mackerel and rice into a nori cone with shredded ginger.

recipes.title: Inari with Avocado Topping
recipes.description: A modern twist on Inari. Sweet tofu pockets filled with sushi rice and topped with fresh, creamy avocado slices.
instructions: Stuff tofu pockets with rice and top each with a fresh slice of avocado.

recipes.title: Octopus Sashimi Salad
recipes.description: A high-protein sashimi dish. Slices of steamed octopus are served over a bed of greens with a zesty ponzu dressing.
instructions: Arrange octopus slices over mixed greens. Drizzle with ponzu and lemon.

recipes.title: Fresh Uni Gunkan
recipes.description: The ultimate delicacy. Fresh sea urchin (Uni) is carefully placed on a nori-wrapped rice ball. Sweet, briny, and incredibly creamy.
instructions: Create nori-wrapped rice 'battleships' and top with fresh uni. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Seared Albacore with Garlic Chips
recipes.description: Tender albacore tuna, lightly seared and topped with crispy, toasted garlic chips for a savory and aromatic crunch.
instructions: Sear albacore and place on rice. Top with a golden garlic chip and a drop of ponzu.

recipes.title: Yellowtail Jalapeño Roll
recipes.description: A modern spicy roll. Creamy yellowtail is paired with the sharp heat of fresh jalapeño and a bright yuzu-soy glaze.
instructions: Roll yellowtail and cucumber. Top each piece with a thin slice of jalapeño.

recipes.title: Simmered Shiitake Nigiri
recipes.description: Earthy shiitake mushrooms simmered in a sweet soy glaze and pressed onto sushi rice. A savory vegan alternative to fish.
instructions: Butterfly simmered mushrooms and press onto rice ovals. Secure with a nori strip.

recipes.title: Shrimp Avocado Hand Roll
recipes.description: A mild and satisfying hand roll. Steamed shrimp and creamy avocado are wrapped in a crisp nori cone for a quick, healthy snack.
instructions: Roll shrimp and avocado into a nori cone with rice and a drop of lemon juice.

recipes.title: Roasted Sweet Potato Crunch Roll
recipes.description: A healthy vegetarian roll. Roasted sweet potato provides a natural sweetness, while toasted panko breadcrumbs add a satisfying crunch.
instructions: Roll roasted sweet potato in rice. Sprinkle with toasted panko for a healthy crunch.

recipes.title: Traditional Giant Futomaki
recipes.description: The classic large roll. Packed with colorful ingredients including egg, spinach, and mushrooms, it’s as beautiful as it is nutritious.
instructions: Create a very thick roll using a full sheet of nori and a variety of traditional fillings. Slice into 1-inch rounds.

recipes.title: Salmon and Lemon Nigiri
recipes.description: Fresh salmon nigiri topped with a paper-thin slice of lemon. The acidity of the lemon cuts through the rich fat of the salmon perfectly.
instructions: Place salmon on rice. Top with a tiny, paper-thin slice of lemon for a bright finish.

recipes.title: Diced Tuna Gunkan
recipes.description: A simple and delicious 'battleship' roll topped with high-quality diced tuna and a hint of wasabi.
instructions: Wrap rice in nori and top with freshly diced tuna.

recipes.title: Cooked Shrimp Maki
recipes.description: A simple and light thin roll featuring steamed shrimp. Perfect for those who prefer their seafood cooked.
instructions: Roll steamed shrimp in rice and nori. Slice into small rounds.

recipes.title: Inari with Fresh Scallions
recipes.description: Sweet tofu pockets filled with sushi rice and topped with sharp, fresh scallions to balance the sweetness.
instructions: Stuff pockets with rice and top with finely minced scallions.

recipes.title: Mackerel Nigiri (Saba)
recipes.description: Salt and vinegar-cured mackerel pressed onto sushi rice. Its bold and tangy flavor is a hallmark of traditional sushi.
instructions: Slice the cured mackerel and press onto rice mounds.

recipes.title: Squid Nigiri (Ika)
recipes.description: Pure white, tender squid pressed onto rice. Known for its mild sweetness and unique chewy texture.
instructions: Score the squid in a diamond pattern and press onto bite-sized rice mounds.

recipes.title: Seared Red Snapper Nigiri
recipes.description: Red snapper nigiri that has been lightly seared on top to bring out its sweetness and add a delicate smokey aroma.
instructions: Place snapper on rice. Briefly sear the top. Season with a tiny drop of yuzu pepper.

recipes.title: Cucumber Skinny Roll (Kappa Maki)
recipes.description: The most basic and refreshing sushi roll. Just crisp cucumber and rice wrapped in nori.
instructions: Roll thin cucumber matchsticks in nori and rice. Slice into 6 small rounds.

recipes.title: Spicy Tuna Hand Roll
recipes.description: Hand-minced tuna mixed with a spicy kick, rolled into a cone shape. Best enjoyed immediately for maximum nori crunch.
instructions: Mix tuna with sriracha. Roll into a cone with rice, cucumber, and radish sprouts.

recipes.title: Salmon Avocado Hand Roll
recipes.description: Creamy avocado and fresh salmon in a convenient hand-held cone. A perfect balance of flavor and texture.
instructions: Roll salmon, avocado, and rice into a nori cone.

recipes.title: Yellowtail Scallion Hand Roll
recipes.description: Buttery yellowtail minced with fresh scallions, served in a crisp nori cone.
instructions: Mince yellowtail and scallions together. Roll into a cone with rice.

recipes.title: Garden Inari Sushi
recipes.description: Sweet inari pockets filled with rice that has been mixed with finely diced carrots and cucumber for extra crunch.
instructions: Mix diced veggies with sushi rice. Stuff into tofu pockets.

recipes.title: Amberjack Hand Roll
recipes.description: Elegant amberjack (Kanpachi) in a fresh hand roll. Its mild and sophisticated flavor is complemented by crisp radish sprouts.
instructions: Roll amberjack and sprouts in a nori cone with rice.

recipes.title: Creamy Scallop Roll
recipes.description: Sweet scallops diced and mixed with a light, creamy sauce. Rolled with cucumber for a delicate and satisfying roll.
instructions: Mix scallops with yogurt and a dash of lemon. Roll inside nori and rice.

recipes.title: Savory Shiitake Roll
recipes.description: Umami-rich simmered shiitake mushrooms in a simple roll. A perfect vegan option for those who love deep, savory flavors.
instructions: Slice simmered mushrooms and roll with rice and nori.

recipes.title: Steamed Asparagus Hand Roll
recipes.description: A light and healthy vegan hand roll. Tender steamed asparagus and sesame seeds in a crisp nori cone.
instructions: Roll steamed asparagus and toasted sesame seeds in a nori cone with rice.

recipes.title: Bluefin Tuna Sashimi Plate
recipes.description: Pure slices of the highest grade bluefin tuna. Served with fresh daikon radish and real wasabi to highlight the fish's natural quality.
instructions: Arrange fresh tuna slices on a bed of grated daikon radish. Serve with wasabi.

recipes.title: King Salmon Sashimi Plate
recipes.description: Rich and buttery slices of King Salmon. High in omega-3 fatty acids and served simply to respect the ingredient.
instructions: Arrange salmon slices on a plate with fresh lemon and ginger.

recipes.title: Grilled Eel Nigiri (Unagi)
recipes.description: Sweet and smoky grilled eel pressed onto rice. Securely bound with a traditional thin strip of nori.
instructions: Slice grilled eel and press onto rice ovals. Secure with a thin nori strip.

recipes.title: Sweet Egg Maki Roll
recipes.description: A thin roll (Hoso-maki) featuring traditional Japanese sweet omelet. A simple and classic sushi staple.
instructions: Roll egg strips and rice in nori. Slice into 6 rounds.

recipes.title: Chef's Mixed Sashimi Platter
recipes.description: An assortment of the day's freshest catches. Typically includes a variety of textures and flavors from tuna, salmon, and white fish.
instructions: Arrange a variety of fresh fish slices beautifully on a plate with traditional garnishes.

recipes.title: Healthy Chirashi Bowl
recipes.description: A 'scattered' sushi bowl. A colorful variety of fresh fish and vegetables served over a bed of seasoned sushi rice.
instructions: Place warm sushi rice in a bowl. Decoratively arrange fresh fish slices and vegetables on top.

recipes.title: Yellowtail and Lemon Nigiri
recipes.description: Buttery yellowtail topped with a paper-thin slice of lemon. A zesty and refreshing take on traditional nigiri.
instructions: Press yellowtail on rice. Top each with a tiny, paper-thin lemon slice.

recipes.title: Spicy Yellowtail Hand Roll
recipes.description: Creamy yellowtail with a spicy kick, rolled in a crisp nori cone. High in protein and bold in flavor.
instructions: Mix yellowtail with sriracha and roll into a nori cone with rice.

recipes.title: Salmon Sashimi Lettuce Tacos
recipes.description: A light and healthy fusion dish. Fresh salmon sashimi served in crisp lettuce leaves with a touch of wasabi-yogurt sauce.
instructions: Place salmon slices inside lettuce leaves. Top with a drop of wasabi-yogurt.

recipes.title: Simple Avocado Nigiri
recipes.description: A simple and delicious vegan nigiri. Ripe avocado slices are pressed onto rice and secured with a thin nori band.
instructions: Press avocado onto rice mounds. Secure with a thin strip of nori.

recipes.title: Cucumber Hand Roll
recipes.description: The ultimate simple and refreshing hand roll. Cool cucumber matchsticks in a crisp nori cone.
instructions: Roll cucumber and rice into a nori cone. Eat immediately.
